uncertainties: CAP region merges historical Cappadocia and Galatia into one code; alternated the controlling entity by slice (galatians -270..-146, pontus_kingdom at -100 reflecting Mithridates VI's 115-100 BC annexation drive, cappadocia at -60 after Ariobarzanes I's Roman-backed restoration c.96-95 BC, galatians again -44/-31 for Deiotarus/Amyntas) rather than showing both simultaneously.

AEG (Cyclades) allegiance in the 3rd-2nd century BC is genuinely contested in scholarship (Ptolemaic Nesiotic League vs. Antigonid naval hegemony after Cos/Andros, dates disputed ~255-245 BC); assigned ptolemaic_egypt(-270)->macedon(-241,-218,-201)->rhodes(-168, transitional)->rome(-146 on) as a defensible simplification.

LEV region merges Phoenicia with Judea/Palestine; assigned to whichever power was dominant each slice (Ptolemaic, then Seleucid, then Hasmonean Judea from -100), which understates Phoenician cities' distinct status.
Massalia's territory in PRO is treated as folded into Rome from -44 onward following Caesar's 49 BC siege, even though the city itself retained nominal free-ally status for some time after.

Mauretania (MAR/RIF/ORA) assigned to direct Roman administration at -31 reflecting the historical 33-25 BC interregnum after Bocchus II's death, before Juba II's 25 BC installation (just after this slice).

Burebista's Dacia at -60/-44 is shown holding all of HUN (Pannonian plain) per the era brief, though ancient sources describe his reach into Pannonia/Thrace only impressionistically; TRN/WLC/MDA are its firmer core.
Population figures for Seleucid, Parthian and Ptolemaic entities (total-empire, largely off-map) are order-of-magnitude estimates following McEvedy & Jones-style ranges, not precise censuses.

Illyrian regions at -31 reflect Octavian's 35-33 BC Illyrian War narrowly (Iapodes/CRO and Delmatae coast/DAL to Rome); the interior (BOS, SRB/Dardania) and most of Pannonia (HUN) remained unconquered until Tiberius's 12-9 BC campaigns, per era05's continuity.

Numidia/Carthage border in Tripolitania (TRP): corrected during research to show Carthage holding it through -168, Numidia from -146 (Masinissa's seizure begun 162 BC, confirmed 146 BC) through -60, and Rome from -44 (Caesar's Africa Nova annexation, 46 BC) — an initial draft had mistakenly routed it through Rome earlier.

Sardinia/Corsica are shown transitioning from Carthage to Rome at slice -218 (historically 238 BC, the Mercenary War aftermath) since no slice falls exactly on that year; Malta is shown Roman from -218 (seized early in the Second Punic War) rather than at -241.
Sarmatians are shown displacing Scythians as of slice -201 ('by -200' per the brief); the exact transition was gradual over decades and any single year is a simplification.

Noricum is treated as a coalescing/allied Celtic federation from -201 (tribes uniting 'from 200 BC' per sources) rather than a fully sovereign kingdom; before that AUT is folded into generic La Tène Celtic tribes.

GEO (Colchis-Iberia) is kept with caucasian_iberia at -100 even though Mithridates VI had annexed coastal Colchis by c. 100 BC; the cell also covers interior Iberia, which stayed independent throughout.
